title: With the pointer over a scrollable view, scrolling visually updates the highlighted item only after the complete animated scroll effect is finished
line: Scrolling in Kickoff now keeps highlighting the item under the pointer, in app lists and in the category sidebar.
explanation: Kickoff's item delegates turned hover off for 200 ms after every wheel event (added in 5368861d87 so scrolling over the category sidebar wouldn't switch categories). In app and search lists this left the highlight on the item that scrolled away until the wheel stopped, and in the sidebar it dropped the hover highlight of the category under the pointer, so it blinked with every wheel notch even when the sidebar couldn't scroll. The change keeps hover on everywhere; only the category switch on hover (switchCategoryOnHover) is skipped while scrolling, and the hovered category is selected once scrolling stops, as before.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: keep hover working while scrolling

Hover was turned off for 200 ms after each wheel event so scrolling over
the sidebar wouldn't switch categories, but that left app lists on a
stale item and made the hovered category blink. Only delay the switch.

BUG: 509188

review.text: Minimal, well-scoped fix in `AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml` that restricts the 200 ms `movedWithWheel` hover suppression to category sidebar items (`root.isCategoryListItem`), where it is needed to avoid accidental category switching while scrolling. App and search lists/grids now keep hover highlighting aligned with the pointer during wheel scrolling (and in non-scrollable views), while preserving sidebar and keyboard-navigation behavior. Before/after screenshots and videos clearly prove the fix.

reviews.text: Minimal, well-scoped fix in `AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml` that restricts the 200 ms `movedWithWheel` hover suppression to category sidebar items (`root.isCategoryListItem`), where it is needed to avoid accidental category switching while scrolling. App and search lists/grids now keep hover highlighting aligned with the pointer during wheel scrolling (and in non-scrollable views), while preserving sidebar and keyboard-navigation behavior. Before/after screenshots and videos clearly prove the fix.

Both earlier requests are resolved. hoverEnabled no longer depends on movedWithWheel for any delegate, so hover visuals stay on everywhere. onEntered skips only the category currentIndex change while wheeling, and a small Connections re-emits entered when movedWithWheel ends, keeping 5368861d87's 'don't switch categories while scrolling, select after' behaviour for switchCategoryOnHover. before/after-3 and -4 show the reporter's c2 sidebar blink gone at default settings, and -1/-2 still show the app list highlight following the pointer. The setting-on case and the keyboard/open-animation hover blocks were checked, and the commit message and line now cover the sidebar.

history.text: The diagnosis is right: the 200 ms movedWithWheel hover block in AbstractKickoffItemDelegate makes app and search lists keep a stale highlight. Lifting the block there is clean, and the before/after media prove that part. But the reporter's c2 attachment (Video_2026-10-21, last ~7 s) shows the other half of the report: wheeling over the non-scrollable category sidebar (Internet, Sistema) makes the hover highlight under the pointer blink off and on. That happens because hoverEnabled goes false there, and this patch deliberately keeps the block for categories. With the default switchCategoryOnHover off, onEntered already returns early for categories, so in that case the block only hides the hover highlight and protects nothing, so the bug as reported (c2: 'even with elements in areas that are capable of being scrollable but currently aren't') stays open.
changes: Keep the category hover highlight while wheeling: only apply the movedWithWheel block to category items when Plasmoid.configuration.switchCategoryOnHover is on (and ideally, even then, keep hover visuals and skip only the currentIndex change in onEntered), so the sidebar highlight no longer blinks

Verify by wheeling over the category sidebar with the pointer on a category (default settings and with switchCategoryOnHover on): the highlight stays on the hovered category and the category does not switch; add before/after media of that case and update commit message/line to cover the sidebar

history.summary: Hover is no longer turned off while wheeling, for categories either: only the switchCategoryOnHover category switch is skipped during the 200 ms wheel window, and the hovered category is selected when it ends. The sidebar highlight no longer blinks, new before/after media show it, and the commit message and line now cover the sidebar.

answers.request: Keep the category hover highlight while wheeling: only apply the movedWithWheel block to category items when Plasmoid.configuration.switchCategoryOnHover is on (and ideally, even then, keep hover visuals and skip only the currentIndex change in onEntered), so the sidebar highlight no longer blinks
answers.answer: Done the ideal way: movedWithWheel is gone from the MouseArea's hoverEnabled, so hover visuals stay on for every item. onEntered now returns early for category items while view.movedWithWheel is set (on top of the existing switchCategoryOnHover check), so only the currentIndex change is skipped. To keep the old behaviour of selecting the hovered category once scrolling stops (which the hoverEnabled toggle used to do by re-sending HoverEnter), a Connections on the view re-emits mouseArea.entered() when movedWithWheel goes false while a category is hovered; onEntered's own checks (setting, keyboard) still apply.

answers.request: Verify by wheeling over the category sidebar with the pointer on a category (default settings and with switchCategoryOnHover on): the highlight stays on the hovered category and the category does not switch; add before/after media of that case and update commit message/line to cover the sidebar
answers.answer: Verified on kdetest6. Default settings: master's Internet highlight drops for ~200 ms on every notch (before-3.mp4, before-4.png); with the fix it stays in every frame and All Applications stays selected (after-3.mp4, after-4.png). switchCategoryOnHover on: the hovered category stays highlighted and selected while wheeling; with a temporary log build, a category that came under the pointer during the wheel window was only selected when the window ended, and with the setting off no category changed. Commit message and line now mention the sidebar.
